# CharacterCreation options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

13 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `CharacterCreation`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowTwoSideAccounts` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | vmangos AllowTwoSide.Accounts (default off): one account may hold both factions on a PvP realm. |
| `CharSectionsDbcPath` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | The build-5875 CharSections.dbc (10 fields), supplied by the developer and never downloaded. Together with `CharacterFacialHairStylesDbcPath` it turns on vmangos Player::ValidateAppearance: a CMSG_CHAR_CREATE whose skin, face, hair or facial hair the client could not have offered is refused with CHAR_CREATE_FAILED. Both empty: appearance is not checked. Only one set, or a configured file that is unreadable or has another layout, refuses startup. |
| `CharacterFacialHairStylesDbcPath` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | The build-5875 CharacterFacialHairStyles.dbc (9 fields); see `CharSectionsDbcPath`. |
| `CharactersCreatingDisabled` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | vmangos CharactersCreatingDisabled (World.cpp:629): bit 0 stops Alliance, bit 1 stops Horde creations for ordinary players (CharacterHandler.cpp:193-216). Default 0. |
| `GameType` | `RealmGameType` | `Normal` | Normal \| PvP \| Normal2 \| Rp \| RpPvP \| FfaPvP | World | start | vmangos GameType (World.cpp:600): PvP, RP-PvP and FFA realms are "PvP realms" (World.h:802). Values: `Normal`, `PvP`, `Normal2`, `Rp`, `RpPvP`, `FfaPvP`. |
| `GmStartLevel` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | vmangos GM.StartLevel (default 1), clamped to StartPlayerLevel..MAX_LEVEL (100); used for accounts above player security (World.cpp:677, Player.cpp:16217). |
| `MinPlayerName` | `int` | `2` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | vmangos MinPlayerName (default 2), clamped to 2..12 (World.cpp:621). |
| `Mode` | `CharacterCreationMode` | `Retail` | Retail \| Legacy | World | start | Retail (default) or Legacy (the old permissive behaviour). Values: `Retail`, `Legacy`. |
| `RealmZone` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | vmangos RealmZone (RealmZone.h:23-61), selects the name alphabet with StrictPlayerNames bit 2. The vmangos default is 1 (development). |
| `StartActions` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Give new characters their `playercreateinfo_action` bar (vmangos MasterPlayer::Create). False leaves it empty. |
| `StartPlayerLevel` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | vmangos StartPlayerLevel (default 1), clamped to 1..MaxPlayerLevel (World.cpp:673). |
| `StartPlayerMoney` | `long` | `0` | a whole number, -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807 | World | start | vmangos StartPlayerMoney in copper (default 0), clamped to 0..MAX_MONEY_AMOUNT (World.cpp:674). |
| `StrictPlayerNames` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | vmangos StrictPlayerNames (0 any one script, bit 1 basic Latin, bit 2 realm zone script). |
